verdict.rationale: Chroma has no explicit policy or opt-out about training AI models on customer data. It does let users keep data entirely under their own control: it is Apache 2.0 and can run locally or self-hosted, offers single-tenant BYOC deployments in the customer's VPC, and works with any embedding model, so data need not go to a third-party API. That keeps data out of the vendor's hands structurally, but nothing in the evidence addresses training use, especially for the managed Chroma Cloud service. Missing for 10: a documented no-training or data-usage policy for Chroma Cloud, an explicit opt-out control, contractual or DPA terms on model training, and independent corroboration.
